commit.message:
wip(import): STEP meshes no coarser than half the gouge verdict (#689, held)

Held, not for merge: with the chord cap the issue's bore passes and the
0.05 mm oversize bore is refused (bore_facet_sagitta), but contours on
Milling-test.step now trip the solid law by 0.010-0.012 mm - the arc fit
spends its whole tolerance toward the part, which the coarse mesh's
chord margin used to hide. See the issue comment.

Refs #689

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAAAJyAPrC37zBzbbX

fix(arcs): arc fit and arc reading leave the STEP mesh its share of the gouge verdict

With the STEP chord cap (previous commit) the bore at the hole's own size
verifies clean, but contours on Milling-test.step then read 0.010-0.012 mm
gouges: the mesh's chords, the arc fit and the verifier's arc reading had
each been allowed the whole 0.01 mm verdict.

- fit_arcs: a replaced vertex stands within ARC_FIT_VERTEX_SHARE (half)
  of tol of its circle; the chord-hug test keeps the full tol.
- fit_arcs: a closing ring takes its turning direction from its signed
  area, not the anchor triple that read regular rims backwards (every
  closed rim ended on a chord; on the Ø25 hole the kinked seam tangent
  made the lead-out cross the ring).
- verify law (b) reads arc moves at a quarter of the gouge tolerance
  (ARC_READ_SHARE): the inscribed chords at the full tolerance falsely
  convicted nominal arcs round convex walls and hid real gouge on
  concave ones. The verdict is unchanged.
- lead_in/lead_out move to arc_leads.rs (400-line law).
- Tests: fit_arcs vertex share and closed-rim pins; shoulder_adaptive
  reads arc moves along their arc; wall_arc_entry's seam/bore note
  assertions follow the capped mesh (the laws stay asserted).

Decisions in docs/decisions/689-step-chord-cap.md.

Fixes #689

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(import): the STEP chord cap is 0.005 mm in the file's own unit

The importer tessellates in the STEP file's length unit and scales to mm
afterwards (#306), but compared the 0.005 mm cap in file units: an inch
file was capped at 0.127 mm (the inch Milling-test kept 0.022 mm chords
and the #689 bore was still refused as a 20 mm gouge), a metre file at
5 m (never bound). The cap is now MAX_CHORD / mm_per_unit; the reduced-
fidelity log prints mm and fires against the unfloored target.

MIN_TOL rises to 1e-5 file units (10x truck's weld TOLERANCE): at
5e-6 m truck split the metre AP214 sample non-manifold. A metre file
therefore reaches 0.01 mm (from ~0.03), logged as reduced fidelity; mm
and inch files are unaffected.

Pins (step_chord_units, with testdata/models/Milling-test-inch.step -
Milling-test.step with an INCH unit and every length / 25.4): the inch
mesh's chord error in mm is <= 0.005 on both curved walls (0.00492 /
0.00495, as the mm file), a bore at the inch hole's own size posts
clean, 0.05 mm oversize is refused.

Fixes #689

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(verify): law (b) reads both joint sets of an arc outside Area mode

The quarter-tolerance arc reading (ARC_READ_SHARE) and the old one put
their chord joints at different places: 3 chords at tol become 5 at
tol / 4, so an old joint is not a new one. Outside Area mode law (b)
reads an arc only at its joints, and a sharp wall vertex on an old
joint fell between two new ones: a gouge 50 um past the floor the old
reading convicted passed. The law now reads the union of both joint
sets. Joints lie on the arc and never read closer than the truth, so
the union adds no false gouge and keeps every old conviction; Area mode
is unchanged.

Pinned by verify_arc_reading
boundary_mode_keeps_the_old_joints_so_a_sharp_vertex_on_one_stays_convicted.
Also corrects the 4096-gon comment (8.8 um inside its circle, not 1e-8).

Fixes #689
